sn55.19:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn55.19:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso …pe… devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
sn55.19:1.3: atha kho sambahulā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatāyo …pe… āyasmā mahāmoggallāno etadavoca:
sn55.19:2.1: “sādhu kho āvuso, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti:
sn55.19:2.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti
sn55.19:2.3: buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā.
sn55.19:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.19:2.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti.
sn55.19:3.1: sādhu kho mārisa moggallāna, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti:
sn55.19:3.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.19:3.3: buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho mārisa moggallāna, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā.
sn55.19:3.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.19:3.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho mārisa moggallāna, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti.
